EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My No.: MN/DS/L/D1/AQ/WPP/01. Land Ministry No.: 4 - 3/2/2017/CEB/238. I, hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section 7, of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land /servitude which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the land or Servitude to be acquired:- The lands allotment called Perukadipannaikani in total extent of about 2.4522 Hectares depicted as Lot No. 1 in Plan No. MN 798 and prepared by Surveyor General situated in the village called Konnayankudiyiruppu, in the Grama Niladari Division No. 62 of Thoddaveli, in the Divisional Secretary’s division of Mannar Town of Mannar District in Northern Province. Plan No.: MN 798 Lot No.01 Name of the land: Perukadipannaikani; Present Use of the Land: Bare Land; Claimant: Government; Original Claimant: Not Known; Extent: 2.4522 Hectares.

The dates and the time of the inquiries: All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at 10.00 a.m. on the 22nd day of March 2019 at Mannar Town Divisional Secretariat.

and Further, you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 15th day of March 2019 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for the compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
K. SIVASAMPU, Divisional Secretary, Mannar Town Division, Mannar.
Divisional Secretariat of Mannar Town, 22nd February, 2019. 03-481
